design.name: 爆竹蛊虫
design.brief: A chunky desert beetle turned into a living bomb by the bandits' Gu sorcery (蛊): a round, high-domed sand-gold carapace with bronze-capped ridges and painted gold cloud-scroll patterns, red paper firecracker bundles (爆竹) and a swollen, veined, glowing ember-orange powder sac strapped onto its back with crimson cloth and hemp rope (its weak spot), a short lit fuse, a yellow paper talisman pasted on the sac, a string of square-holed copper coins hanging on its side, a small armoured head with two glowing ember-orange eyes and curved dark mandibles, six stubby clawed legs. Cute but menacing, readable as a beetle from any angle.
